steps.en: Run one installer that detects your agents and wires their hooks, commands and skills
steps.zh: 一条安装命令识别本机 agent，写好其 hook、命令与 skills

steps.en: When your agent reaches plan approval, the registered hook catches that call
steps.zh: agent 走到计划批准时，已注册的 hook 接住这次调用

steps.en: Starts a short-lived local server and opens the plan in your browser
steps.zh: 起一个用完即走的本地服务器，把计划在浏览器里打开

steps.en: Read the rendered plan and annotate the exact lines you want changed
steps.zh: 读渲染好的计划，逐条标注你要改的地方

steps.en: Blocks until you decide: approve passes silently, annotations return as a block reason
steps.zh: 阻塞到你做决定：批准就静默放行，批注以 block 理由返回

steps.en: On your next plan, shows a diff of what changed since the version you reviewed
steps.zh: 下次提交同一计划时，给出与你上轮所审版本的差异

value.en: Your review lands inside the agent loop — no pasting the plan into chat, no explaining which line you meant
value.zh: 评审直接落在 agent 循环里——不用把计划贴回聊天，也不用解释你指的是哪一行

sources: README.md Install: `curl -fsSL https://plannotator.ai/install.sh | bash`; Commands: `/plannotator-review`, `/plannotator-annotate`, `/plannotator-last`, `plannotator sessions`
README.md How it works -> Plan review: ExitPlanMode -> PermissionRequest hook -> local server reads the plan -> browser review UI -> approve/deny -> feedback to agent -> plan diff on resubmission

apps/marketing/src/content/docs/guides/hook-integration.md: `--hook` decision matrix — approve/close = empty stdout, Send Annotations = `{"decision":"block","reason":"<feedback>"}`, exit code always 0
